al-8843.subject: H1 Economics

parts.form: [Data-response] Using Extract/Figure [n], describe/compare the change in [indicator] over [period].
parts.count: several per case study (~16 marks of data-response per case)
parts.stimulus: 2-3 pages of text extracts, tables and charts on a current economic issue

parts.form: Explain, with a diagram, how [event in data] affects [price/output/revenue] in [market].
Discuss whether/the extent to which [policy] is the best way for [government] to address [issue].
parts.count: 1-2 per case (~24 higher-order marks per case)

command_words.Describe/Compare (data): identify trends, magnitudes and contrasts from the figures
command_words.Explain: apply concept or diagram to the case with step-by-step reasoning
command_words.Account for: give economic causes of an observed change
command_words.Discuss: two-sided analysis ending in a reasoned judgement
command_words.Assess/Evaluate: weigh effectiveness, assumptions and context to reach a judgement

how_marks_are_earned: AO1 knowledge, AO2 interpreting data and its limitations, AO3 applying concepts to the case, AO4 evaluation
Higher-order parts reward use of case evidence, not generic theory
About 60% of marks involve evaluation-type skills
marking.evaluation: Judgement that weighs policy effectiveness, unstated assumptions and context (e.g. Singapore's small open economy); synthesis into a reasoned conclusion
common_mark_loss: Theory without application to the specific economy/market

style_notes: Two compulsory case studies of 40 marks, each with 7-8 parts including sub-parts
Early parts read off data; later parts escalate to explain then discuss
Contexts are contemporary, often Singapore or named economies, mixing micro and macro
No essays in H1

parts.form: Section A Pure: e.g. Find [derivative/stationary points/area] of [function]; hence [optimise/sketch].

parts.form: Section B Stats: probability, binomial/normal, sampling, hypothesis test, regression, multi-part.

command_words.Show that: derive the given result; every step required
command_words.Sketch: graph with shape, intercepts, turning points, asymptotes labelled

Not sketching the graph used to solve
